vetSays.line: 🛡️ Ming, Marisol, Carmen and Chantal met them at the door — 4 put down. Ming, Marisol, Carmen, Chantal are hurt.
🛡️ Ming, Frieda, Marisol and Chantal met them at the door — 4 put down. Ming, Frieda, Marisol, Chantal are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Frieda just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Liliane just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ming, Frieda, Marisol, Carmen and Liliane met them at the door — 5 put down. Ming, Frieda, Marisol, Carmen, Liliane are hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Marcus — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Marcus chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ming just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Frieda just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ming, Frieda, Marisol, Chantal and Adaeze met them at the door — 5 put down. Ming, Frieda, Marisol, Chantal, Adaeze are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
Adaeze strikes the Elder Chorus Line.
The Elder Chorus Line falls.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Adaeze just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Frieda, Marisol, Liliane, Chantal and Marcus met them at the door — 5 put down. Frieda, Marisol, Liliane, Chantal, Marcus are hurt.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Marcus Webb, 41 — an electrician. His hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Berserker Rage, Lucky Rock, Cold-Blooded, Night Eyes.
Cold-blooded: your body budgets like an accountant. (-20% food need today)

📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Almas just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Almas, Ada and Kojo met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off. Ada didn't come back. Almas, Kojo are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Almas just put down The Influencer... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
